purpose: two-domain comparison of interpolated label conversion
starting_checkpoints: fixed T0 from each method seed 1 and 2; branch diagnostic, not full training
train: site2 train; 20 epochs, batch8, fixed RNG 1106; restored optimizer, TED teacher, S3R anchor and importance; S3R shape prior 50 epochs as source run
evaluation: site1 and site2 val after epoch20; foreground micro Dice and prediction/reference rates; primary uses 0.5 labels in both arms and original-label evaluation is also reported
selection: each method separately must complete all four arms, finite models/optimizers, mean improvement across 2 seeds and 2 sites at least .03 with both seed means positive and no site mean drop over .02, to qualify for independent follow-up only
caveats: 0.5 is a convention, not verified original ground truth; fixed T0 branches and independent GPU arithmetic are not full reproduction or bitwise pairing
stop: any nonfinite loss, gradient, parameter or optimizer; loss>10000; any arm failure, deadline or storage cap; no automatic retries
